      "text": "This error message means that a file required to run the game (**nw_elf.dll**) is missing from the folder where `Game.exe` is located. This file is part of **NW.js**, a framework used by many indie games (often those made with RPG Maker MV/MZ or Construct).\n\nHere are the three most likely reasons this happened and how to fix them:\n\n### 1. You are running the game directly from a ZIP file\nThis is the most common cause. If you downloaded the game as a `.zip` or `.rar` file and double-clicked `Game.exe` without extracting it first, the game cannot \"see\" the other files in the package.\n\n*   **The Fix:** Close the error. Go back to the downloaded file, **Right-click** the ZIP file, and select **\"Extract All...\"** or **\"Extract Here.\"** Once extracted, open the *new* folder and run `Game.exe` from there.\n\n### 2. Your Antivirus ate the file\nBecause `nw_elf.dll` is a file that executes code (scripts), Windows Defender or other antivirus software often mistakenly flags it as a virus (a \"false positive\") and quarantines it.\n\n*   **The Fix:**\n    *   Open your antivirus software (or **Windows Security** \u003e **Virus \u0026 threat protection**).\n    *   Look for **\"Protection History\"** or **\"Quarantine.\"**\n    *   If you see `nw_elf.dll` listed there, select it and choose **\"Restore\"** or **\"Allow.\"**\n    *   To prevent this from happening again, you may need to add the game\u0027s folder to your antivirus \"Exclusion\" or \"Exception\" list.\n\n### 3. The download was corrupted or incomplete\nIf the download was interrupted, the file might simply not be there.\n\n*   **The Fix:** Delete the current game folder, download the game again, and ensure the download finishes completely before extracting it.\n\n---\n\n**⚠️ IMPORTANT:** Do **NOT** try to download `nw_elf.dll` from random \"DLL download\" websites. Those files can contain malware or be the wrong version for your specific game. Only get the file by extracting the original game download or restoring it from your antivirus.",
